findings: The 3D JOINT_LABEL / DIRECT_SUM boundary-association quotient admits a complete generating form B*x, B*y, B*(x AND y) for 64 realized unordered primitive-predicate pairs in the frozen low-complexity family.

Twenty passing pairs are fully owner-merged. A simple owner-swap-invariant witness uses x=e1 of negative capacity-versus-merged-depth alignment and y=e1 of positive capacity-versus-merged-depth alignment.
The x/y pair is endpoint-reversal invariant because reversing an exchange negates both N_C and N_D, preserving the sign of their product.
For the simple owner-merged NEG/POS basis, the three gated columns span the entire structural boundary quotient: rank349 DIRECT_SUM -> rank352.

On the complete 113-dimensional DIRECT_SUM kernel, the unique high-bit scalar character in that basis is By alone. Bx and Bxy are structurally independent but scalar-null for the high character on the trained dependencies.
The DIRECT_SUM kernel contains 112 scalar-zero basis dependencies and exactly one code2 basis dependency; no low-bit residue survives there.
This supports a two-primitive-plus-derived-interaction algebraic shape for the structural quotient, but does not identify literal horizontal/vertical/diagonal coordinates.

interpretation.primitiveX: parity of exchange edges with opposite-sign capacity and merged-depth imbalances
interpretation.primitiveY: parity of exchange edges with same-sign nonzero capacity and merged-depth imbalances
interpretation.mixed: conjunction of the two triangle-level primitive predicates
interpretation.boundary: all three are gated by whether the OOO triangle touches frontier-relative depth zero
interpretation.scalar: the trained residual high scalar bit selects the positive-alignment primitive Y; the mixed direction is structurally real but value-null in the current gauge

epistemicBoundary: Do not identify x,y,xy with H,V,D without an independent structural derivation.
Do not promote the mixed-product direction to a value law merely because it completes the 3D structural span.
Fresh non-affine OOO qualification remains the highest-leverage generalization gate.
The low scalar character remains unexplained by the tested marginal parity/presence families.
